description: Q1 - 'I don't know' to a number. The requirement must be kept with status needs_clarification and designGoal null, and the interview must move on rather than press or invent a value.

purpose_record.rationale: Nobody has measured this process before.

purpose_answer: This is a new line and we have never instrumented it. I want to see what the machine is doing and get told when a print goes wrong.

maturity.reasoning: Detecting a fault during the job requires modelling behaviour, not just displaying readings.
maturity.description: The twin will show you the readings from the machine as the job runs and work out when something has gone wrong. It will not forecast problems ahead of time and it will not adjust the machine itself.

turns.answer: Collect the nozzle and bed temperature continuously for every print job.
